title: The Haunted Build
description:
Everybody buys one prop at a time. One inflatable in October, a string of lights the year after, and the house still looks like a house with something in the garden.

This is the whole yard, in one delivery, built to work together. The lights are the colours that make the fog read. The fog sits low because it is chilled. The sound comes from behind the graves, not from the porch. Every piece is chosen because of what it does to the piece next to it.

You are not buying decorations. You are buying the house the street walks to.

images.alt: The whole front, built and running
